name: next-steps
description: After each turn, 2 or 3 likely next prompts above the prompt. Press 1, 2 or 3 in an empty prompt to draft one, 0 to dismiss.

language.title: Language
language.description: Write the suggestions in this language (e.g. Korean). Empty keeps English.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto: one row when the list fits, one per row otherwise. rows: always one suggestion per row.
